en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a large neo-Gothic church with a prominent clock tower and spire, reflected symmetrically in water in the foreground. The upper part of the image has the printed text 'Sundsvalls kyrka.' The reverse side contains handwritten Swedish text, an address, a green 5 öre Swedish stamp, and postmarks. The publisher 'Mesch & Jonsson Missionsbokhandel, Sundsvall' is printed along the side.
